notes: This file covers California districts 1-26 only (districts 27-52 are in another group). District numbers are the 2026 (Proposition 50) map. Results mainly from the NBC Los Angeles House map (NBC News Decision Desk); its figures matched California Secretary of State counts dated 13 Nov 2026 for CA-23. CA-23 uncalled: Republican Rep. Jay Obernolte leads Democrat Tessa Lynn Hodge 108,006 (50.8%) to 104,728 (49.2%) with about 97% of expected vote in; no AP or NBC call found, winner left empty. CA-4: called by AP only on 13 Nov 2026 (KQED); Jones 52.5% vs Thompson 47.5%. Ami Bera (sitting, old CA-6) won the new CA-3; Kevin Kiley (sitting CA-3, now independent) lost in CA-6. James Gallagher (sitting CA-1) lost to McGuire. Brownley not running is from a search-result snippet of an NBC page, not a page I opened. Villegas background sources differ (educator / college professor / school board member). Ballotpedia pages returned empty on fetch, so not used.
